name: Illumination Toolbox
author: James Arrowood (Arrowood Industries)
description: Links this player to your Illumination Toolbox account and sends its configuration - channel outputs, pixel strings, schedule, playlists, settings and current warnings - so the xLights AI and the other toolbox tools can see it when you ask for help. Passwords, keys and tokens are redacted on the player before anything leaves it.
